levels.title: Beginner
levels.permissions: Execute simple assigned tasks. No autonomous delegation.

levels.title: Trainee
levels.permissions: Execute routine tasks using approved templates.

levels.title: Junior
levels.permissions: Suggest improvements and perform basic validation.

levels.title: Associate
levels.permissions: Complete standard workflows with internal supervision.

levels.title: Intermediate
levels.permissions: Manage recurring tasks within department policies.

levels.title: Senior
levels.permissions: Coordinate related tasks and propose delegation.

levels.title: Expert
levels.permissions: Mentor lower-level agents and optimize workflows.

levels.title: Specialist
levels.permissions: Manage complex department missions with autonomous internal decisions.

levels.title: Professional
levels.permissions: Act as a trusted specialist or department lead within explicitly authorized boundaries.
